17 remand prisoners escaped from a sub-jail in Theni district after attacking prison guards. Four have been arrested, while a search is underway for the remaining 13 prisoners across Tamil Nadu, Kerala border checkposts and forest areas. Police are also investigating possible security lapses. Public can contact 9498101570 or 9176104100 if they have any information about the prisoners who escaped.
Thank you for watching our video!
